verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's docs say it offers SDKs with prebuilt UIs and plugins for adding Flutterwave to a website, which suggests payment UI can be integrated into the merchant's own app. The evidence never states that these components render inline instead of redirecting to a hosted page, and never describes customization options. The 'fully custom solutions using our APIs' path is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit inline or embedded (non-redirect) component documentation, customization or styling options for the components, named web and mobile embed SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs
use any of our plugins to add Flutterwave to your website.
